meta.title: 生物电子转移（ET）文献数据考古：Marcus 反转区与 β 因子谱
meta.purpose: 检验化学间隙层 v0.1 与 Marcus 反转区争议的兼容性；间隙跳跃理论数据底座
verification_channels: PubMed eutils (esearch/esummary/efetch) — 摘要全文核验
Europe PMC REST API — 摘要/全文核验
NCBI PMC efetch — 开放获取全文核验
Nobel Prize 官网 PDF (nobelprize.org/uploads/2018/06/marcus-lecture.pdf) — 讲稿全文核验（经代理 http://127.0.0.1:7890）
Wikipedia wikitext via api.wikimedia.org/core/v1/wikipedia/en/page/Marcus_theory — 二级来源（经代理）
meta.discipline_note: 每个数值只来自上述通道实际访问到的文本；未访问到的标 unverified 并放入待核验参考。Semantic Scholar API 本次 429 限流未用上。

A1_marcus_original_prediction.claim: Marcus 原始论文：On the Theory of Oxidation-Reduction Reactions Involving Electron Transfer. I，J. Chem. Phys. 24, 966-978 (1956)
A1_marcus_original_prediction.value: DOI: 10.1063/1.1742723; JCP vol 24, pp 966-978; 1956-05-01; 作者 R.A. Marcus (Polytechnic Institute of Brooklyn)
A1_marcus_original_prediction.note: Crossref 元数据逐字核验（题目/作者/容器/卷/页/年份）。

A1_marcus_original_prediction.claim: Marcus Nobel 讲稿：Electron Transfer Reactions in Chemistry: Theory and Experiment, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 32, 1111-1121 (1993)
A1_marcus_original_prediction.note: Crossref 核验。讲稿原题中为 Theory and Experiment（任务书写作 theory and practice，实际标题为 Theory and Experiment，Angew 版）。

A1_marcus_original_prediction.claim: 反转区数学形式：k_ET 对 -ΔG° 呈抛物线（高斯型），-ΔG° 超过 λ 后速率反转下降；ΔG‡ = (λ+ΔG°)²/4λ
A1_marcus_original_prediction.value: Nobel 讲稿原文（PDF 全文已下载解析）：'Another prediction in the 1960 paper concerned what I termed there the inverted region: In a series of related reactions, similar in λ but differing in [ΔG°]...the activation free energy...is seen from Eq. (5b) to [decrease then increase]'；'The Inverted Region Effect' 图 8 展示 log k 对 -ΔG° 的反转曲线
A1_marcus_original_prediction.note: PDF 全文经代理下载（449,838 字节, 12 页），pdftotext 解析后逐句定位。公式编号 (5b)/(10) 为讲稿原文引用。

A1_marcus_original_prediction.claim: Wikipedia (二级来源) 对反转区历史的表述：'Scientists searched the inverted region for proof of a slower electron transfer rate for 30 years until it was unequivocally verified experimentally in 1984'，引 Miller/Calcaterra/Closs JACS 1984, 106, 3047
A1_marcus_original_prediction.value: 维基百科引文逐字；其引用的首次观测文献为 J.R. Miller, L.T. Calcaterra, G.L. Closs, JACS 1984, 106, 3047, doi:10.1021/ja00322a058
A1_marcus_original_prediction.note: wikitext 全文经代理取得（41,269 字符）。二级来源，仅作历史脉络，不作数值依据。

A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.claim: 化学体系反转区实验确认之一（刚性分子内 D-bridge-A 系统，Miller/Beitz/Huddleston）：Effect of free energy on rates of electron transfer between molecules, JACS 1984, 106, 5057-5068
A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.value: DOI: 10.1021/ja00330a004; JACS vol 106, pp 5057-5068; 1984-09; 作者 Miller, Beitz, Huddleston
A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.note: Crossref 逐字核验。此为 2D 量热/电荷复合系列工作（前作为 Miller & Beitz JCP 74, 6746 (1981), DOI: 10.1063/1.441078，亦核验）。

A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.claim: 化学体系反转区实验确认之二（Marcus 本人在 Nobel 讲稿中指认的'最佳实验证据'）：Miller, Calcaterra, Closs, JACS 1984, 106, 3047-3049
A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.value: Nobel 讲稿原文：'The best experimental evidence for the inverted region was provided in 1984 by Miller, Calcaterra and Closs, almost 25 years after it was predicted.'；其参考文献表 ref.3 列 'J.R. Miller, L.T. Calcaterra and G.L. Gloss [Closs 印刷变体], J. Am. Chem. Soc. 106, 3047 (1984)'
A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.note: DOI 独立核验：10.1021/ja00322a058（Crossref 返回 'Intramolecular long-distance electron transfer in radical anions. The effects of free energy and solvent on the reaction rates', JACS 106, 3047-3049, 1984-05）。

A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.claim: 前置间接证据（化学发光）：反转区效应导致高放能 ET 走向化学发光通道（Marcus 讲稿讨论）
A2_first_observation_in_chemical_systems.value: Nobel 讲稿：'indirect evidence for the inverted region had been obtained by observing that electron transfer reactions with a very negative ΔG° may result in chemiluminescence'

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [正例·蛋白质纯体系首次确认] 工程化 azurin 系列长程 ET 展示 Marcus 反转区行为（'protein-only' 系统）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Farver, Hosseinzadeh, Marshall, Wherland, Lu, Pecht, J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 2015, 6, 100-105, DOI: 10.1021/jz5022685, PMID 26263097。摘要原文：'evidence of the inverted region in a "protein-only" system has remained elusive. We herein provide such evidence in a series of nonderivatized proteins.'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: PubMed 摘要全文逐字。核心：非衍生化（无外接氧化还原辅基）蛋白体系中首次。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [正例·PSII] 光系统 II D1 蛋白变体中 S(n)TyrZ•QA-• 电荷复合发生于 Marcus 反转区（-ΔG°≈1.2 eV, 32 Å 单步隧穿）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Boussac, Rappaport, Brettel, Sugiura, J. Phys. Chem. B 2013, 117, 3308-3314, DOI: 10.1021/jp400337j, PMID 23448315。摘要原文：'These observations indicate that the charge recombination occurs in the Marcus inverted region. Assuming that the driving force of the reaction (-ΔG° ≈ 1.2 eV at room temperature for S1)...'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: 数值 -ΔG°≈1.2 eV、距离 ~32 Å、ket(S1)=3.4e-3 s-1 均出自摘要原文。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [正例·迷你金属蛋白] 迷你 CuI 金属蛋白（maquette）经碰撞 ET 在反转 Marcus 区进行
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Hong, Kharenko, Fan, Xie, Petros, Gibney, Ogawa, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2006, 45, 6137-6140, DOI: 10.1002/anie.200601517, PMID 16927358。标题即 'Evidence that a miniature CuI metalloprotein undergoes collisional electron transfer in the inverted Marcus region'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: PubMed 摘要无正文（短文），标题即结论。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [正例·Zn-细胞色素c/细胞色素氧化酶] 高驱动力 1.1 eV 使正向 ET 进入反转区（因此观测不到 ET 产物——逆反应更快）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Brzezinski, Sundahl, Adelroth, Wilson, el-Agez, Wittung, Malmström, Biophys. Chem. 1995, 54, 191-197, DOI: 10.1016/0301-4622(94)00128-7, PMID 7756569。摘要原文：'This can be explained by the high driving force (1.1 eV) for the forward electron transfer, taking the system into the inverted Marcus region.'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: 数值 1.1 eV 出自摘要原文。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [正例·FMN 结合蛋白] 细小 FMN 结合蛋白光诱导 ET 主要在正常区、部分进入反转区（Marcus-Hush vs Kakitani-Mataga 分析）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Nunthaboot, Pianwanit, Kokpol, Tanaka, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2011, 13, 6085-6097, DOI: 10.1039/c0cp02634d, PMID 21347481。摘要原文：'The PET in these FBP isomers mostly took place in the so-called normal region, and partly in the inverted region.'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: 理论拟合宣称（KM 拟合优于 MH），非纯实验直接观测，强度弱于前几条。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [正例·黄素氧还蛋白] 飞秒尺度黄素蛋白短程 ET：反转区内背 ET 势垒有效降低，振动耦合电荷复合加速（0.95-1.6 ps）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: He, Guo, Guo, Chang, Wang, Zhong, Biochemistry 2013, 52, 9120-9128, DOI: 10.1021/bi401137u, PMID 24289221。摘要原文：'the back ET barrier is effectively reduced because of the decrease in the total free energy in the Marcus inverted region, leading to the accelerated charge recombination.'

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [经典反例解释·光合反应中心] 反转区效应是光合反应中心功能的要素：小 λ（~0.25 eV）抑制 BPh-→P+ 电荷复合（~1.1 eV 高放能过程慢）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Marcus Nobel 讲稿原文：'It has been suggested that the small λ (~0.25eV) and the resulting inverted region effect play a significant role in providing this essential condition for the effectiveness of the photosynthetic reaction center.'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: λ~0.25 eV 与 ~1.1 eV 均出自讲稿原文。这是'反转区在生物中确实起作用'的最早权威表述（1992）。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [负例·经典说法背景] 早期实验（如 Rb. sphaeroides 反应中心 P+HA- 电荷复合速率与 P/P+ 中点电位无关）表明天然体系驱动 force 依赖性复杂，简单 Marcus 反转区图像需修正
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: Tang, Williams, Taguchi, Allen, Woodbury, Biochemistry 1999, 38, 8794-8799, DOI: 10.1021/bi990346q, PMID 10393555。标题：'P+HA- charge recombination reaction rate constant in Rhodobacter sphaeroides reaction centers is independent of the P/P+ midpoint potential.'（摘要获取不完整，仅标题+DOI核验）
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: DOI 经 Crossref 核验；摘要文本被截断，仅以标题结论入档。

A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.claim: [综述性确认] 单分子结中 Fe-S 蛋白复合物显示 Marcus 反转区（电流在高偏压下饱和/下降），确认 hopping 为限速步骤
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.value: 综述（Single-Molecule Conductance of Non-Redox Proteins, Biomolecules 2026, 16, 495, DOI: 10.3390/biom16040495, PMC13521894/PMC13113700）原文：'Single-molecule studies of Fe-S protein complexes reveal the Marcus inverted region, where current saturates or declines at high bias, confirming hopping as the rate-limiting process.'
A3_inverted_region_in_biological_systems.note: 二级来源（2026 综述）全文核验；原始单分子文献未追溯。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: 蛋白质内经典 ET 距离衰减典型值 β ≈ 1.0-1.4 Å⁻¹（红氧还蛋白特异共因子间相干隧穿）
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: 综述原文（PMC 全文）：'In classical biological electron transfer (ET), redox proteins are constrained by coherent tunneling between specific cofactors and exhibit a steep distance dependence (β ≈ 1.0–1.4 Å⁻¹)'. 出处：Single-Molecule Conductance of Non-Redox Proteins, Biomolecules 2026, 16(4), 495, DOI: 10.3390/biom16040495
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: 这就是任务书问的'哪个文献给出蛋白质内 β 典型值 1.0-1.4 Å⁻¹'的开放获取答案（2026 综述明确写出该区间）。一级经典出处为 Moser/Dutton 系列（Moser et al. Nature 1992, 355, 796-802, DOI: 10.1038/355796a0，已核验 DOI 与摘要：'A variation of 20 A in the distance...changes the electron-transfer rate by 10^12-fold'，由 10^12/20Å 可反推 β≈1.38 Å⁻¹，属计算性核验，原文本句不含显式 β 数字）。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: Ru 修饰 azurin（P. aeruginosa）β-折叠链（M121 β-strand）上 ET 距离衰减常数 β = 1.1 Å⁻¹（Gray/Winkler 组经典实验）
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: Langen, Chang, Germanas, Richards, Winkler, Gray, Science 1995, 268, 1733-1735, DOI: 10.1126/science.7792598, PMID 7792598。摘要原文：'The Cu+ to Ru3+ rate constants yielded a distance-decay constant of 1.1 per angstrom, a value close to the distance-decay constant of 1.0 per angstrom predicted for electron tunneling through an idealized beta strand.'
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: β=1.1 Å⁻¹ 与理想化 β 链理论值 1.0 Å⁻¹ 均出自摘要原文。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: Ru-azurin 全体系电子耦合衰减参数 β = 1.1 Å⁻¹、H_AB0 = 186 cm⁻¹、d0 = 3 Å（作为标准参数组在后续理论工作中引用）
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: PMC 全文（Fluctuating hydrogen-bond networks govern anomalous electron transfer kinetics in a blue copper protein, PMC6004490, PMID 29844178）原文：'using the experimentally determined values of H_AB0 = 186 cm−1, d0 = 3 Å, and β = 1.1 Å−1 for all mutants (8, 28)'
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: 二级引用，指向 Gray & Winkler PNAS 2005, 102, 3534-3539 (DOI: 10.1073/pnas.0408029102) 与 Warren et al. JACS 2013, 135, 11151 (DOI: 10.1021/ja403734n)，两者 DOI 均经 PMC 参考文献表核验。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: Gray & Winkler 综述（PNAS 2005）对共价/氢键耦合强于 van der Waals 间隙耦合的确认（β 谱的机理基础）
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: 摘要原文：'Couplings through covalent and hydrogen bonds are much stronger than those across van der Waals gaps, and these differences in coupling between bonded and nonbonded atoms account for the dependence of tunneling rates on the structure of the media between redox sites in Ru-modified proteins.' 出处：PNAS 2005, 102, 3534-3539, DOI: 10.1073/pnas.0408029102
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: 该文未在摘要给出显式 β 数字（0.7/1.1 分档数值在正文/后续书籍章节中，本次未核验到显式数值）。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: [未核验·待核验参考] 常被引用的分档 β 谱：共价路径 β≈0.7 Å⁻¹、氢键/水界面中间值、空间跃迁（through-space）β≈1.1 Å⁻¹、饱和烷烃链 β≈1.0 Å⁻¹（Closs/Miller 化学体系经典值）
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: 共价 0.7 Å⁻¹：未核验（本次开放获取通道未拿到含该显式数字的可核验文本；候选来源为 Winkler & Gray Chem. Rev. 1992, 92, 369-379, DOI: 10.1021/cr00011a001（DOI 已核验存在，正文未取得）；以及 Gray & Winkler Q. Rev. Biophys. 2003, 36, 341-372, DOI: 10.1017/s0033583503003913（DOI 已核验存在，摘要无该数字）。空间跃迁 1.1 Å⁻¹ 已由 Langen 1995（β 链）与 PMC6004490（Ru-azurin 全体系）双重核验。饱和烷烃 ~1.0 Å⁻¹ 已核验于 Biomolecules 2026 综述：'saturated alkane chains (~1.0 Å⁻¹)'。
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: 纪律执行：0.7 数值本身未核验，只入待核验参考字段；不可写入理论正文作核验值。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: [对照谱·hopping] 单分子结中利用氧化还原中心作 hopping 中介时衰减大减：β ≈ 0.1-0.3 Å⁻¹（红氧还蛋白）、0.1-0.6 Å⁻¹（非红氧还蛋白）、0.1-0.2 Å⁻¹（大型非红氧还蛋白）
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: Biomolecules 2026, 16, 495 综述原文：'redox proteins...utilize their redox centers as efficient hopping intermediates, which drastically reduces the decay constant (β ≈ 0.1–0.3 Å⁻¹)'；'non-redox proteins exhibit...decay constants (β ≈ 0.1–0.6 Å⁻¹)'；'large non-redox proteins...exhibit remarkably similar low β values (≈0.1–0.2 Å⁻¹)'
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: 这是间隙跳跃图像的谱学对照：隧穿 β 谱（1.0-1.4）与 hopping β 谱（0.1-0.3）之间差一个量级——与'间隙驻留形成/消失'的图像直接相关。

taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.claim: 生物 ET 直接隧穿距离上限 ~14 Å（红氧还中心间距），超过则需辅因子链——Page/Moser/Chen/Dutton, Nature 1999, 402, 47-52
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.value: 摘要原文（Europe PMC 全文核验）：'electrons can travel up to 14 A between redox centres through the protein medium. Transfer over longer distances always involves a chain of cofactors.' DOI: 10.1038/46972
taskB_beta_factor_spectrum.note: Moser 1992 Nature（DOI: 10.1038/355796a0）同已核验：20 Å 变化 → 10^12 倍速率变化。两文共同构成 β≈1.0-1.4 Å⁻¹ 的一级实验底座。

taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.claim: 学术界正式定义'门控电子转移'：观测速率何时由构象互变控制（即 Marcus 速率常数只在构象/门控态就绪后才有意义）
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.value: Hoffman, Ratner, 'Gated electron transfer: when are observed rates controlled by conformational interconversion?', JACS 1987, 109, 6237-6243, DOI: 10.1021/ja00255a003（勘误 JACS 1988, 110, 8267, DOI: 10.1021/ja00232a067）
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.note: Crossref 核验（标题/作者/卷/页/年份+勘误）。这是'gated ET'术语的定义性文献。

taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.claim: 实验确认构象门控：Zn-细胞色素c→质体蓝素光诱导 ET 被蛋白表面扩散（构象搜索）门控
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.value: Zhou, Kostic, JACS 1992, 114, 3562-3563, DOI: 10.1021/ja00035a065（标题：'Photoinduced electron transfer from zinc cytochrome c to plastocyanin is gated by surface diffusion within the metalloprotein complex'）；后续：Zhou, Kostic, JACS 1993, 115, 10796-10804, DOI: 10.1021/ja00076a042
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.note: 两篇 DOI 均核验；1993 文标题 'Gating of photoinduced electron transfer from zinc cytochrome c and tin cytochrome c to plastocyanin'。

taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.claim: 早期实验证据：黄素细胞色素 b2 内 ET 受丙酮酸结合诱导的构象门控（1991，先于 Hoffman/Ratner 术语定型的实验落实）
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.value: Walker, Tollin, Biochemistry 1991, 30, 5546-5555, DOI: 10.1021/bi00236a030。Europe PMC 摘要核验（结论句为构象门控证据）

taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.claim: Davidson 组系统区分'true / gated / coupled ET'三类动力学——确认生物 ET 中非 ET 步骤（构象/化学门控）可以限速，即 Marcus 速率只描述门控已打开后的那一步
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.value: Davidson, Acc. Chem. Res. 2008, 41, 1145-1152（标题 'Protein control of true, gated, and coupled electron transfer reactions', PMID 18442271, DOI 10.1021/ar800049z——DOI 待核验，标题/年份/期刊经 Europe PMC 核验）。摘要原文：'The analysis of protein ET reactions is complicated by the fact that non-ET processes might influence the observed ET rate in kinetically complex biological systems.'
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.note: PMID/标题/摘要核验；精确卷页与 DOI 未逐一回查（标注于此）。另有 Davidson, Biochemistry 2002, 41, 'Chemically gated electron transfer...' (PMID 12475211) 摘要核验：'the faster activated ET reaction is gated (i.e., rate-limited) [by a preceding chemical step]'。

taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.claim: 细胞色素 c/cytochrome b2 复合物 ET 构象门控证据（McLendon 组）
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.value: McLendon, Pardue, Bak, JACS 1987, 109, 7540-7541, DOI: 10.1021/ja00258a054（标题 'Electron transfer in the cytochrome c/cytochrome b2 complex: evidence for conformational gating'）

taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.claim: [待核验参考] 任务书提到的 McCleskey/Weller 门控文献
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.value: 未在本次通道找到 McCleskey 主作者的'gated ET'论文条目（Crossref 作者检索返回的是 McCleskey/Burns 铀化学与 Weller 激基复合物文献）。存在一组 Zhou & Kostic 1991 JACS 113, 6067-6073 (DOI: 10.1021/ja00016a021) 报告 Zn-细胞色素c/质体蓝素静态+扩散 ET 动力学（DOI 已核验）。McCleskey 名下门控经典文献（若存在）待进一步核验；任务书对该条目的记忆未获本次来源支持。
taskC_marcus_precondition_gating.note: 按去幻纪律：不能凭训练记忆补 McCleskey 1984 JACS 卷页；该条目留待核验。门控文献链已由 Hoffman/Ratner 1987 + Zhou/Kostic + McLendon + Walker/Tollin + Davidson 完整支撑，不影响任务C结论。

synthesis_for_gap_layer_theory.key_finding_1: Marcus 反转区并非'在生物体内从未观测到'：1992 年 Marcus 本人 Nobel 讲稿即指出光合反应中心小 λ（~0.25 eV）+ 反转区效应是其功能要素；2013 PSII（-ΔG°≈1.2 eV, 32 Å）、2015 工程化 azurin（protein-only 首次）、2006 mini-maquette、1995 Zn-cyt c/CcO（1.1 eV）等均报告了生物/蛋白体系反转区行为。
synthesis_for_gap_layer_theory.key_finding_2: 更准确的经典说法是：天然生物 ET 链的工作点被进化约束在'正常区+激活区'——红氧还中心间距 ≤14 Å（Page/Dutton 1999）、驱动 force 由辅因子电位精细调定，绝大多数生理 ET 不进入反转区，但生物体系并非原则上观测不到反转区。
synthesis_for_gap_layer_theory.key_finding_3: 对化学间隙层理论的关键兼容性证据：gated ET 文献链（Hoffman/Ratner 1987 定义 → Zhou/Kostic、McLendon、Davidson 实验体系化）确认 Marcus 速率描述的是'门控已打开后'的 ET 事件——即间隙/给受对构象已就绪之后的速率；这与'间隙跳跃=间隙驻留的依次形成-消失'同构：Marcus 动力学管的是驻留存在后的跃迁，间隙驻留的形成-消失由门控（构象）动力学管。
synthesis_for_gap_layer_theory.key_finding_4: β 谱的分档（hopping 0.1-0.3 vs 隧穿 1.0-1.4 Å⁻¹）与空间跃迁 1.1 Å⁻¹（Langen 1995）为'间隙驻留'提供了谱学标尺：转变点即'间隙是否作为实驻留态参与输运'的分界。
